entities.summary: Adebisi Akanji (1935–2023) was a Nigerian artist as well as the Olúwo of Ilédì Lárọ̀ Ohùntótó - the main Ògbóni Ìbílẹ̀ lodge of Òṣogbo, capital of Ọ̀ṣun State, Nigeria.
